The '''Talz Training Camp''' was a training facility established on the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talz Training Camp appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an area on Hoth.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
